Hardeep Singh Puri made a striking remark at ETM 2026 about India’s energy strategy.
He said, “I am a Sardar from outside, but a Bania when it comes to energy,” while discussing crude oil purchases. Puri explained why India took advantage of discounted Russian crude oil despite Western price caps. He also addressed questions around US pressure and India’s energy security and trade interests. The development comes as Puri has been named BJP’s candidate for the Rajya Sabha bypoll from Madhya Pradesh.
